import bisect, sys, json, ipaddress, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/tests')
from reference import version_frontier, reference_runs, brute_case
from protocol import parse_request
from audit import decode_image, LANES
payload = json.load(open('/tmp/case2.json'))
req = parse_request(json.dumps(payload).encode())
out = json.loads(subprocess.run(['python3','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(payload).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout.decode())
res = out['cases'][0]
case = req[0]
fib={}
for route,hop in case['initial']: fib[route]=hop
hists=[dict(fib)]
for tx in case['transactions']:
    for op,route,hop in tx:
        if op=='set': fib[route]=hop
        elif route in fib: del fib[route]
    hists.append(dict(fib))
hit,miss,dec = case['costs']
tot_work=0; tot_pages=0
for vi,v in enumerate(res['versions']):
    starts=[int(x,16) for x in v['starts']]
    nodes,size=decode_image(v['image'],starts,v['hops'])
    tot_pages+=size
    print('version',vi,'R',len(starts),'pages',size)
    for off,n in sorted(nodes.items()):
        print('   off',off,'kind',n['kind'],'mode',n['mode'],'cached',n['cached'],'lo',n['lo'],'span',n['span'],'P',n['pages'],'children',n['children'])
    bl=[(rep,[int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(a)) for a in addrs]) for vv,rep,addrs in case['bursts'] if vv==vi]
    fr=version_frontier(starts,v['hops'],bl,case['cache_pages'],hit,miss,dec)
    fr.sort()
    print('   frontier(best 8):',fr[:8])
    # recompute work for this version
    work=0
    for vv,repeat,addrs in case['bursts']:
        if vv!=vi: continue
        visits={};touched=set()
        for a in addrs:
            ai=int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(a))
            off=64;path=[]
            while True:
                path.append(off);n=nodes[off]
                r=bisect.bisect_right(n['keys'],ai)
                if n['kind']==1:
                    run=n['lo']+r-1;break
                off=n['children'][r]
            for o in path: visits[o]=visits.get(o,0)+1
            touched.update(path)
        for o in touched:
            n=nodes[o];k=len(n['keys'])
            work+=repeat*(n['pages']*(hit if n['cached'] else miss)+((k+LANES[n['mode']]-1)//LANES[n['mode']]+dec[n['mode']])*visits[o])
    print('   my work',work)
    tot_work+=work
print('total',[tot_work,tot_pages],'reported',res['objective'])
